# New legendary mods in the Burning Springs update

![New Legendary Mods in Burning Springs Update](/uploads/577_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Some new legendary mods and effects were tested on the current PTS for the Burning Springs update, which will be released on December 2nd, 2025. Some new 1,2 and 3 star mods have now been developed. There is currently no new 4 star mod. The special thing about these mods is that **special legendary mods for ghouls** are now included. In all likelihood, these mods will appear in the next update. However, changes are always possible up until the release.

**Important: These new legendary mods are only available in Burning Springs in the Bounty Hunt: Head Hunt and Bounty Hunt: Routine Hunt events.**

## New legendary 1 star mods
